description: Verify whether a company is active, dissolved, in liquidation, deregistered, bankrupt, deleted, or unknown in FirmaDB's latest government-sourced data. Use this for KYB, vendor checks, CRM hygiene, and any agent workflow that needs a compact decision rather than a full company profile. Returns a JSON object with: country, registry_id, name, status (one of the 7 canonical values), status_active (bool), dissolution_date (or null), source_url, data_freshness, confidence ('registry' or 'unknown'), and request_id. Do NOT treat unknown as active; ask for human review or use the source URL.
name: firmadb_verify_status
